  "extractions": [
    {
      "unit": "P001:P004",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "concepts": [
          {
            "label": "Prohibited carriage on person or accessible property",
            "definition": "Prohibition against having a weapon, explosive, or incendiary on or about an individual's person or accessible property during inspection, in sterile areas, or when boarding/onboard screened aircraft.",
            "quote": "an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property",
            "role": "rkaf:assignmentPrimary"
          }
        ],
        "claimants": [],
        "typed_values": [],
        "effective_periods": [],
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": ["P001:P004"],
        "scope_text": "Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": ["P002", "P003", "P004"],
        "choice_quote": "P002:P004",
        "choice_text": "Either (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.",
        "logic_text": "(1) When performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) When the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) When the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.",
        "actor_quote": "an individual",
